title: Vibrant Arabian Bake
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish inspired by the spices of the Arabian Peninsula, featuring the crunch of eggplant in a tasty bake.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange the eggplant slices on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the Arabian olive oil over the eggplant and sprinkle with Vibrant spice blend.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, mix the Saudian yogurt with a pinch of salt and a sprinkle of Vibrant spice blend.
Once the eggplant is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Top the eggplant with the yogurt mixture and sprinkle with Crunchy pita chips.
